claim: November is KL's wettest month; Dec-Jan combine the monsoon, peak crowds and 40-60% price premiums; 2026 is Visit Malaysia Year.
quote: November is KL's wettest month (~373 mm); Dec-Jan combines monsoon, peak crowds and 40-60% price premiums; 2026 is Visit Malaysia Year.

claim: Malaysia 2026: Thaipusam 2 Feb, Chinese New Year 17-18 Feb, Hari Raya Aidilfitri 21-22 Mar, Wesak 31 May, Merdeka 31 Aug, Deepavali 8 Nov.
quote: Chinese New Year 17-18 Feb, Thaipusam 2 Feb, Hari Raya Aidilfitri 21-22 Mar, Hari Raya Haji 27 May, Wesak 31 May, Merdeka 31 Aug, Deepavali 8 Nov.

claim: Petronas Twin Towers tickets are sold on an official e-ticket platform, are limited and first-come-first-served, and are best bought in advance.
quote: Official Petronas e-ticket platform; tickets are limited, first come first served, and best bought in advance.

claim: Petronas Twin Towers use timed-entry ticketing; arrive 15 minutes before your slot or it is cancelled; closed Mondays.
quote: Petronas Twin Towers run a timed-entry ticketing system; visitors must arrive 15 minutes before their slot or it is cancelled.

claim: Merdeka 118 is the world's second-tallest building at 678.9 m, with observation decks on floors 115-116.
quote: Merdeka 118 is the world's second-tallest building at 678.9 m with observation decks on floors 115-116.

claim: Merdeka 118's observation deck and mall are not yet open to the public.
quote: Official Merdeka 118 site; observation deck and mall not yet open to the public.

claim: Batu Caves is open daily roughly 06:00-21:00 and the main Temple Cave is free to visit.
quote: Batu Caves is open daily roughly 06:00-21:00 and the main Temple Cave is free to visit.

claim: Thaipusam 2026 falls on 1 February and is celebrated at Batu Caves with the Silver Chariot procession from Sri Maha Mariamman Temple.
quote: Thaipusam 2026 falls on 1 February and is celebrated at Batu Caves with the Silver Chariot procession from Sri Maha Mariamman Temple.

claim: Batu Caves expected 2.5-3.5 million Thaipusam visitors in 2026, with road closures 30 Jan-3 Feb.
quote: Batu Caves expected 2.5-3.5 million Thaipusam visitors in 2026, with road closures Jan 30-Feb 3.

claim: Jalan Alor is KL's most famous open-air food street; stalls peak in the evening and a full meal runs under RM20.
quote: Jalan Alor is KL's most famous open-air food street; stalls peak in the evening and a full meal runs under RM20.

claim: Klang, about an hour from KL, is the origin of Malaysian herbal bak kut teh.
quote: Klang is the origin of Malaysian herbal bak kut teh, an hour from KL.

claim: Nasi Lemak Wanjo in Kampung Baru is a legendary nasi lemak with a deep spread of lauk.
quote: Nasi Lemak Wanjo (Kampung Baru) is a legendary nasi lemak with a deep spread of lauk; Tanglin dates to 1948.

claim: The Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia opens 09:30-18:00 daily, adult RM20, closed only on the two Hari Raya.
quote: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia opens 09:30-18:00 daily (last entry 17:30), adult RM20, closed only on the two Hari Raya.

claim: The KL Forest Eco Park canopy walk in the city centre runs ~09:30-16:00 and is closed Mondays and public holidays.
quote: KL Forest Eco Park canopy walk runs ~09:30-16:00, closed Mondays and public holidays.

claim: Kampung Kuantan firefly boats near Kuala Selangor are the only way to see the synchronous fireflies; tours run from KL.
quote: Kampung Kuantan firefly boats are the only way to see the synchronous fireflies; tours run from KL.

claim: Putrajaya is ~25 km south of KL, ~20 min by KLIA Transit or ~40 min by MRT, with the Pink Mosque and a lake boat ride on a ~4h tour.
quote: Putrajaya is ~25 km south, ~20 min by KLIA Transit / ~40 min MRT; Pink Mosque + boat, ~4h tour.

claim: KLIA Ekspres reaches KL Sentral in 28 minutes for RM40, departing every 20 minutes.
quote: KLIA Ekspres reaches KL Sentral in 28 min for RM40, every 20 min; T1-T2 are 3 min apart.

claim: A Grab from KLIA to central KL is RM75-90 off-peak and RM130-180 at peak, about 50 minutes.
quote: Grab from KLIA to central KL is RM75-90 off-peak, RM130-180 at peak, ~50 min.

claim: Brussels-Kuala Lumpur fares run from roughly $646 round trip.
quote: Brussels-Kuala Lumpur fares: from ~$404 one-way, ~$646 round trip.

claim: There is no nonstop Brussels-KL flight; you connect through a hub such as Amsterdam.
quote: No nonstop Brussels-KL flight; you connect through a hub such as Amsterdam.

claim: KL's rail network (MRT/LRT/Monorail/KTM) converges at KL Sentral, with the MRT best for tourists and Grab widely used.
quote: KL rail is MRT/LRT/Monorail/KTM converging at KL Sentral; MRT best for tourists; Grab popular.

claim: Else KL occupies a restored 1931 Art Deco landmark in Chinatown, 49 rooms with a rooftop pool and deck.
quote: Else KL occupies a restored 1931 Art Deco landmark, 49 rooms by Studio Bikin with rattan/timber, rooftop pool and deck.

claim: The Majestic Hotel's heritage Majestic Wing has butler suites, an Orchid Conservatory, a Tea Lounge and afternoon tea in a 1932 landmark.
quote: The Majestic's Majestic Wing offers butler suites, an Orchid Conservatory, a Tea Lounge and afternoon tea; a modern Tower Wing holds the pool.

claim: The Royal Selangor Visitor Centre offers free entry with live pewtersmithing plus paid hands-on workshops.
quote: Royal Selangor Visitor Centre offers free entry with live pewtersmithing, a museum and shop, plus paid hands-on workshops.

claim: KL to Melaka is about a 2h bus; a day-trip works but an overnight is better for the night and weekend food.
quote: KL-Melaka bus is ~2h; a day-trip works but overnight is better for night/weekend food.
